ming: Quick alert — calliope-v1 int8 shows detok spacing differences on vertical JP testset, BLEU dropped 2.4 -> 1.7.

marta: Tokenization or detok?

ming: Token ids match fp16, but int8 detok inserts U+200A/U+202F around parentheses. Repro: `model = load('calliope-v1-int8'); print(detok(model.generate(p)))`.

samir: I recently landed vertical-normalizer mapping ZWSP->THIN_SPACE. Could be related.

anya: Run pytest tests/detok/test_vertical_boundaries.py::test_paren_spacing on int8 vs fp16.

ming: It fails on q8/int8 only. Hex dump confirms extra hair/narrow spaces in int8 outputs.

qa-bot: Failing CI run: https://ci.local/runs/90321 :x:

marta: Plan: revert thin-space mapping and add explicit tests for narrow spaces; also add guard in merge pass to avoid merging tokens producing these codepoints.

samir: Pushed revert branch detok/revert-thinspace-202F and test update. Local CI green.

ming: Added instrumentation to log token id sequences pre/post merge on canary. Found int8 merge collapsed subtokens producing a string that detok then mapped to thin space.

anya: Add rule: if merged surface contains U+202F or U+200A, skip merge. Add regression eval for jp/cn vertical on detok changes.

marta: Agreed. After guard + revert, rerun full eval.

qa-bot: Canary build started for canary/calliope-int8-detok-log (build 90412).

ming: Post-merge jp-vertical BLEU improved to 2.4 (baseline ~2.45). Running larger job tonight.

marta: Flag for eng-ml retro: normalization x quantized-merge interaction. Postmortem + doc from @samir on whitespace fragility.

ming: Closing when nightly passes. Thanks. :rocket:
